cc:Work.dc:title: Point power versus interval energy
cc:Work.dc:description: PCHIP reconstructed power from original half-hour PV samples integrated into quarter-hour energies; hourly energy equals their sum.

g.text: Hour energy = 0.481 + 2.576 + 5.052 + 7.810 = 15.919 Wh. Values shown rounded; integrals computed at full precision.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596579

g.text: Average power over a quarter-hour = its energy / 0.25 h. Summing power samples is not an energy integral.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596579

g.text: PCHIP is a reconstruction assumption, not a measurement of the missing instants. CSi panel, slope 18 degrees, south-facing.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #596579

g.text: Energy bars use exact antiderivative differences. This selected sunrise case is not full-year validation. Atlite c428beeeb7.
